text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Alriiiight, that's game~~!! You're buying 
the ice cream, deal?♪

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! I really thought I could beat Pokke 
at this game~~~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I'm not that soft. So, what's next?

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about one race? I wanna 
run with ya, Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hell yeah! Heh-heh, I'll make it a 
double scoop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Jungle Pocket thoroughly enjoyed 
her day off with her friends.
